items.title: Moderna (MRNA) Faces Norovirus Setback As MFLUSIVA FDA Decision Nears
items.summary: Moderna reported its Q2 update alongside news that its lead norovirus vaccine candidate did not meet early success criteria in a Phase 3 interim analysis, so the trial will continue for further evaluation. The company is awaiting an FDA decision on its seasonal influenza vaccine, mFLUSIVA, which is expected by early August. Management paired these pipeline updates with Q2 results that were ahead of expectations and a revised outlook for operating expenses. For investors watching...

items.title: Moderna Stock Has Doubled This Year. Can Earnings Keep the Rally Alive?
items.summary: Moderna  posted a narrower per-share loss in its latest quarter, but shares traded slightly lower as the company’s earnings report highlighted the drugmaker’s ongoing struggle to break away from its pandemic-driven business model.  Moderna  posted a loss of $1.97 a share, narrower than the loss of $2.01 Wall Street had anticipated, and slimmer than the per-share loss of $2.13 reported last year.  The drugmaker reiterated its full-year guidance of 10% revenue growth, evenly split between U.S. and international sales.
